name: Caminal le Pultaia Sortilège Sisua
original_name: カミナル・ル・プルテア・ソルティレージュ・シスア
source:
[url=/c64302]Sylvie's[/url] sister and the 10th princess of Sortilège. Her nickname is "Mina." She's an insightful person who does not see people for their social or economic status, but on their own personal merits.

However, she does not care for [url=/c64498]Ouro[/url] much as he is far too undisciplined for her liking and does not live up to her standards. Mina pokes her nose into Ouro's business to correct his poor habits for her sister's sake.

"Plebeian, you will not get off lightly if you do anything to Sylvi-oneesama. Understood?"

[From [url=http://kinkoi.nekonyansoft.com/chara06.html]NekoNyan[/url]]
